text.p: These are the leading stories in Zimbabwe's state-owned Herald newspaper on Tuesday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.

- Zimbabwean president Robert Mugabe on Monday told heads of state and government meeting in the resort town of Victoria Falls for the six summit of the Group of 15 developing countries there would be no going back on the controversial Hwange thermal power station deal between the southern African country and YTL Corporation of Malaysia.

- Heads of state and government attending the G-15 summit in Zimbabwe were in the resort town of Victoria Falls on Monday for a day's retreat during which they discussed finer details on improved co-operation among developing countries from the southern continents of the world.
